At about 12, I decided to try and smoke cloves. Ive heard about cloves being kind of relaxing so I decided to try and 'wake and bake'. A very harsh smokes thats almost cooling? It numbs my throat and I salivated allot. I felt very relaxed but not heavy. No high really. The aroma was very pleasant by the way.
